short_description: Air raid alerts for up to three regions of Ukraine or Israel, on your BUSY Bar.
description:
## How to use

In the app's settings, choose up to three regions: Kyiv, any of 23 Ukrainian regions, or Israel.

## What you see

- No alert: NO ALERTS in green.
- An alert: the whole screen turns red with AIR ALERT and the region's name; several regions scroll by.
- When the alert ends: ALL CLEAR in green for a minute.

The app checks every 20 seconds. The BUSY Bar runs one app at a time, so alerts show only while this app is open.

## Data

[ubilling.net.ua aerial alerts](https://ubilling.net.ua/aerialalerts/) for Ukraine and [Tzeva Adom](https://www.tzevaadom.co.il) for Israel, no keys needed.
changelog: First release: up to three regions, a red screen during an alert, all clear for a minute.
